system.description:
You can choose a Target when you attack it or by skipping your Move, declaring it as your Mark until you declare a new Mark. The following rules apply while you have a Mark:


• Your attacks against it with Weapons that have the Keen or Vicious property also have the other property, and Crit if a Bonus causes the result to exceed your Crit range.


• You roll two d20s on Checks to track it, and use the higher result.
